scope: Aborted high-learning-rate H3 topology r1 capacity round
summary: The r1 rank-16 5e-5 route was deliberately stopped after seven steps when the stronger frozen DINOv2 cross-check showed that its r0 predecessor violated the motion non-regression contract and required conservative routing.
evidence: The run completed 7/48 steps of its first planned epoch before receiving SIGTERM.
No checkpoint was emitted, so no interrupted weights can be selected accidentally.
The retained manifest records subprocess exit -15 and zero produced checkpoints.
The routing evidence measured matched motion adherence 0.938565, below the required 0.99 floor, and selected r2-conservative-r16 at learning rate 2e-5.
lessons: A later, stronger non-regression measurement must override a capacity escalation already in progress.
Interrupted candidates must remain unselectable and be recorded rather than silently deleted.
limitations: This controlled stop is not a completed training or quality result.
next_actions: Run the reviewed conservative rank-16 round in a new immutable directory.
